sources: https://www.reservevaparks.com/Web/#!park/22 (US eDirect API prod-va-rdr.recreation-management.tylerapp.com: search/grid for facility 110 Lovers Leap Campground and search/details for each of its 18 units, start date 2027-05-04, read 2026-10-21)

hookups.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/natural-tunnel (Lover's Leap: 'EW - Electric and Water Hookup Sites (LL 01- LL 18) ... Electrical service is 20, 30 and 50-amp') + reservevaparks.com search/details (all 18 sites list 50-amp and water hookup), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Lover's Leap: 18 electric/water sites (LL 01-LL 18) for tents, pop-ups and RVs. DCR's page says RVs up to 50 ft and that all are back-in; the booking site lists a 45-ft vehicle length on every site and marks one of the 18 as pull-through. Two vehicles per site. (The park's other campground, Cove View, is a separate entry.)

sites.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/natural-tunnel ('Lover's Leap Campground - 18 electric-water hookup sites', 'RVs up to 50 feet', 'All are back-in sites') + reservevaparks.com search/details (18 Electric/Water units, VehicleLength 45, 17 Back In / 1 Pull Through), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/natural-tunnel ('The campground bathhouse has showers, restrooms and a laundry facility'; 'The Lover's Leap Campground restroom has a coin-operated laundry'; park amenities 'Dump Station', 'camp store'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'All sites have electricity and water (EW) and are reserved by the site.' Reserve online or at 1-800-933-PARK; a late-arrivals box is outside the camp store. The booking site gives a 14-night maximum on each campsite.

booking.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/natural-tunnel (Camping) + reservevaparks.com search/details ('MaxStay': 14 on all 18 sites), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed reservable by site, 14-night max and the $37 electric/water rate on the booking site (fees left as human-checked 2026-10-12; season already manual and matches 'first Friday in March until the first Monday in December'). Added 50-amp electric and water, 18 sites to 45 ft (DCR says 50), showers, laundry, dump station, camp store. Not stated: sewer, booking window or cutoff for this park, first-come policy.
flags: Missing phone and operator website: Natural Tunnel State Park 276-940-2674, https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/natural-tunnel (the entry has only the booking site and no phone).
